records.note: ADA 'brought to bear in the fight' names no defendant, agency action or observable criterion; the registry holds no ADA event.
Legal inference that accommodations 'might follow' other psychiatric disabilities; no deciding body, case or criterion.
Rhetorical contrast about private equity; no entity, threshold or countable outcome.
Hyperbolic conditional on all doctors and nurses quitting; no writable event and no benchmark.
'Beginning of a remarkable change' is a slogan; the NTAP itself was already public on the statement date.
'This is how psychedelic medicine will be paid for' = Medicare NTAP for a psychedelic medicine. 'In the future' is not a deadline.
Advocacy call plus 'More are coming'; the quantifier has no countable set, payer or setting.
'Coming apocalypse in liability' names no case, plaintiff or count; the registry ERISA event needs a parity pleading.
Rhetorical either-or addressed to executives; no named plan, case or observable enforcement action.
'More suicides will be a big deal' gives no count, series or threshold under the sentinel-event rule.
'An entire new level of seriousness' is not measurable; no hospital count, audit result or guideline change.
A fear about unstated numbers plus a hope about adoption; no threshold and no adoption criterion.
'Well-established medicines' and 'hopeful' set no approval, trial or adoption criterion; 'near future' is not a deadline.
Impact claim about a just-published paper changing readers' understanding; nothing observable to resolve.
Hedged hope that magnesium-ibogaine 'might be' broad-spectrum healing; no approval, pathway or trial event stated.
List heading over seven PTSD technologies 'plausibly useful on the horizon'; no single event or criterion.
'More data coming' for COMP360 in PTSD; no endpoint, trial or date, and no matching registry event.
The further LSD-in-GAD data are a pre-print from his own group, which decides when to release it.
Phrased as a question with 'We shall see'; no entity, threshold or outcome in academic publishing.
Apple Vision Pro as a productivity device; not a drug, device, payer or practice outcome in psychiatry.
'Thousands of others coming' has no named series, court or date; the registry ERISA event requires a parity pleading.
'Just the beginning' restates an earlier call; no case, defendant or countable filing.
'The next enforcement' orders an undefined sequence; no agency, plan or case that a criterion could name.
'A ton of lawsuits in the making' gives no count, court or named plan administrator.
'A stampede towards self-funded plans' has no threshold and no named data series.
'Complete implosion of fully funded plans' sets no measurable threshold or series, although the horizon is datable.
'Many more' PBM lawsuits; a quantifier with no countable set or source.
'Dead in the water in the employer market' is a slogan; no company, share or revenue benchmark.
'Will become popular' names no vendor, contract count or series.
Exhortation with a consequence clause; no named employer, fiduciary or case to resolve on.
Footnote about future defendants at unnamed companies; no case or countable filing.
'Healing is coming' is aspirational; no drug, regulator, trial or adoption criterion.
fMRI-guided neuromodulation as standard of care maps to the guideline first-line TMS event. 'Near future' is not a deadline.
Uptake of chemical castration through primary care 'likely to be low'; no series, threshold or period.
Speculation that GLP-1 medicines may reduce risk; named an open question, with no trial, label or criterion.
'Business models built on this impracticality won't work'; no named company, filing or financial threshold.
'Down for a very long time' sets no duration threshold; the 73-day base rate is context, not his claim.
Describes past access to protected health information as a HIPAA violation; no future state asserted.
'A really important question' names no penalty, filing or decision that could resolve.
Hedged whistleblower expectation; no named person, forum or observable report.
